tamhid.title: Tamhid
tamhid.description: An engaging introduction using thought-provoking questions to provide a glimpse of the verse or surah being studied.

tilawah.title: Tilawah
tilawah.description: Reciting the selected verses with mindfulness to connect the heart with the Qur'an.

tafsir.title: Tafsir
tafsir.description: Briefly explaining key words or phrases in the verse to enhance understanding of its meaning.

tadabbur.title: Tadabbur
tadabbur.description: Reflecting deeply on the verse to uncover lessons, messages, and wisdom within it.

tazkiyah.title: Tazkiyah
tazkiyah.description: Purifying the heart and soul through the verse, strengthening faith, and applying its teachings in daily life.
